title: Retrieval quality review
tests_passed: single-query recursive budget, RRF weights validation, and deterministic tie handling covered
tests_failed: No live retrieval-corpus benchmark was run; this review only verifies deterministic local behavior.
decisions: A max_queries value of one must execute the initial query once; query usage is recorded after the search call.
The P04-T04 through P04-T06 ledger titles were reconciled to original blueprint IDs without rewriting historical commits.
risks: BM25-lite is local, token-based, and non-positional; it has not been calibrated against a production corpus.
RecursiveSearcher's new_doc_bonus_threshold argument is presently not applied, so it must not be presented as an active stopping policy.
follow_up: P05 provenance should populate source and citation metadata for production-scale retrieval evaluation.
